title: Mock Image Bundle Trial Evidence Record
description: Contract for the structured JSON evidence object emitted by scripts/mock_image_bundle_trial_evidence.py. The emitter drives the COMMITTED examples/synthetic_mock_image_trial/ bundle through scripts/run_mock_image_pipeline.py --bundle into a tempfile-owned workspace/output/report directory OUTSIDE the repo tree and records what landed: the produced PPTX (path + existence + size), the runner-written inventory.json (ok / findings / slide_count / media_parts_count / evidence_basis / no_external_relationships and the derived booleans), the runner-written mock_d_one_adapter_plan.json sidecar (schema_version / request_count / requests / placement_role_coverage and the malformed-request gate), and three validator outcomes (validate_pptx_contract / inspect_pptx_inventory / validate_mock_d_one_adapter_plan, including the two booleans that prove the committed descriptor_vocabulary AND --require-both-placement-roles were on the sidecar validator command line). MOCK / STUB only — NOT real D-One integration: no MCP, no public network, no model API, no image search, no Qoder, no telemetry. real_d_one_status is locked to a self-describing UNVERIFIED sentence that names the services NOT called; the validator's semantic gate also refuses any positive success claim about real D-One / MCP / public network / model API / image search / Qoder anywhere in the record. schema_version is locked to '1' and evidence_id is locked to 'mock_image_bundle_trial_evidence' so a future shape change forces a paired schema/validator bump. additionalProperties:false at every declared object level so a tampered record carrying an unrecognised field (smuggle slot) is refused at the schema layer.

schema_version.description: Record-file schema version. Locked to the string '1' today; bumped only with a paired emitter + schema + validator change so a future consumer can refuse a shape it does not recognise.

evidence_id.description: Self-describing record identifier. Locked so a reader scanning a directory of mixed JSON evidence can recognise this record without inspecting the structure.

real_d_one_status.description: Fixed sentence pinned to the literal 'UNVERIFIED' substring AND explicit negation that real D-One / MCP / public network / model API / image search / Qoder / telemetry were called. The validator's semantic gate enforces the substring + negation in addition to the minLength/maxLength bounds the schema can express.

path.description: Path to the produced PPTX under the per-run tempdir. The validator's string-safety scan refuses URI / traversal / credential / public-upload / confidential / raw-source shapes here; --require-files re-checks the path is a regular non-symlink file under a common temp root.

exists.description: True iff the path resolved to a regular non-symlink file at evidence-emission time.

size_bytes.description: Byte length of the produced PPTX. The semantic gate refuses summary.ok=true when this is 0 or exists=false.

rc.description: Exit code from scripts/validate_pptx_contract.py --expected-slide-count 2. Null only when the validator never ran (e.g. the pipeline aborted before the PPTX was produced).

ok.description: True iff rc == 0. The semantic gate refuses summary.ok=true when this is false.

rc.description: Exit code from scripts/inspect_pptx_inventory.py against the produced PPTX. Null only when the validator never ran.

ok.description: True iff rc == 0. The semantic gate refuses summary.ok=true when this is false.

rc.description: Exit code from scripts/validate_mock_d_one_adapter_plan.py against the runner-written sidecar. Null only when the validator never ran (e.g. the runner aborted before writing the sidecar).

ok.description: True iff rc == 0. The semantic gate refuses summary.ok=true when this is false.

vocabulary_gate_used.description: True iff the sidecar validator was invoked with --descriptor-vocabulary against the bundle's committed descriptor_vocabulary.json. The semantic gate refuses summary.ok=true when this is false (the G13 taxonomy gate would not have fired against the sidecar bytes).

require_both_placement_roles_used.description: True iff the sidecar validator was invoked with --require-both-placement-roles. The semantic gate refuses summary.ok=true when this is false (the G9 placement-role gate would not have fired against the sidecar bytes).

path.description: Path to <report-dir>/inventory.json under the per-run tempdir. Same string-safety + --require-files coverage as pptx.path.
Path to <report-dir>/mock_d_one_adapter_plan.json under the per-run tempdir. Same string-safety + --require-files coverage as pptx.path.

id.description: Request id mirrored verbatim from the sidecar requests[]. Non-empty string required by the goal.

placement_role.description: Closed enumeration mirroring scripts/done_image_adapter.py's placement_role surface. Both roles must appear across the requests[] entries (semantic gate G_cover).

text_policy.description: Caller-declared text_policy on the sidecar. Non-empty string required by the goal.

subject_domain.description: Caller-declared subject_domain on the sidecar. Non-empty string required by the goal.

manifest_local_path.description: Workspace-relative local_path mirrored from the manifest. Non-empty string required by the goal; the validator's string-safety scan refuses URI / traversal / credential / public-upload / confidential / raw-source shapes here.

custom_descriptor.description: Optional escape-hatch descriptor; preserved verbatim from the sidecar when the request carries it, omitted otherwise. If present it MUST be a non-empty string.

requests.description: One record per generated request, mirroring the runner-written sidecar's requests[] (taxonomy fields + optional custom_descriptor). The schema enforces per-entry required fields + non-empty string types; the semantic gate enforces all_requests_well_formed / placement-role coverage / request_count == len(requests).

malformed_request_indices.description: Indices into requests[] that the emitter flagged as malformed. The semantic gate refuses summary.ok=true when this list is non-empty.

placement_role_coverage.description: Sorted unique placement_role values observed across requests[]. The semantic gate refuses summary.ok=true unless this equals exactly ['hero_page', 'local_region'].

bundle_path.description: Path to the committed bundle the trial drove. Recorded for trace; the validator's string-safety scan refuses URI / traversal / credential / public-upload / confidential / raw-source shapes here.

report_dir.description: Path to the per-run report directory under the tempdir. Recorded for trace; same string-safety coverage as bundle_path.

scope.description: Fixed framing that names what this evidence does NOT prove (mock chain only, NOT real D-One / MCP / Qoder / public network / model API / image search / telemetry; not a prompt/report-to-PPTX automation). The validator's string-safety scan and real-D-One claim refusal apply here too.

embed_surface.description: Fixed framing for the embed subset scripts/export_pptx.py supports today (PNG/JPG/JPEG under ppt/media/*). Anything outside that subset is fail-closed by the exporter.

ok.description: Single-boolean summary derived from every gate above. The validator refuses summary.ok=true when any of the documented sub-conditions does not hold (see scripts/validate_mock_image_bundle_trial_evidence.py for the full list).
